rounds.text: Vaishali Pharma Ltd trades at an attractive price-to-book ratio of 1.46x against a much higher sector benchmark of 4.17x [E2, E7]. Furthermore, the company's return on assets of 3.28% and return on capital employed of 8.35% both comfortably outperform their respective sector benchmarks of 2.43% and 5.76% [E8, E10]. A discounted cash flow model establishes an intrinsic value of Rs 12 per share compared to the current market price of ₹ 7.72, providing a substantial margin of safety of 38.0% [E42, E43]. This undervaluation is supported by a reverse DCF showing that the current market price implies only 11.4% earnings growth, which is well below the base case assumption of 18.0% [E44]. Fundamental performance has outpaced stock price movement over a five-year period, with profit growing by 31% while the price rose by 15%, highlighting a disconnect between underlying business strength and market valuation [E53]. Conceded: [E4], [E25], [E26], [E27], [E28], [E58], [E67].
